title: Customer account: sign up, verify, my trips, change, cancel
caption: Mirrors tools/e2e/specs/storefront/account-bookings.e2e.ts. Self-service cancellation needs storefront_settings.features.selfServiceCancellation (off for a new OTA). E-mails land in Mailpit.

steps.title: Sign up
steps.body: Name, e-mail, a strong password, accept the terms.
steps.expect: `POST /v1/auth/sign-up` → `201`; cookies `__Host-vx_at` (15 min), `__Host-vx_rt` (HttpOnly) and `__Host-vx_csrf` (readable by JS). Rows: `customers` (active, `email_verified_at` null), `customer_identities` (argon2id), `customer_sessions`, `customer_preferences`, 3 `customer_consents`, `notifications` `auth.verify_email`.

steps.title: Verify the address
steps.body: Open the e-mail in Mailpit and follow the link (`/account/verify.html?token=…`).
steps.expect: `POST /v1/auth/email-verification/confirm` → `200`; `email_verified_at` set; guest bookings of that address attached to the account (unless marked `customer.erased`). The token works once (`400 VERIFICATION_TOKEN_INVALID` the second time).

steps.title: Sign out and in
steps.body: Sign out, sign in again; try a wrong password 5 times on another address.
steps.expect: `204` then `200`; the session row revoked/new. Five failures → `423 ACCOUNT_LOCKED` (Redis `t:<tenantId>:test:authfail:<sha256(email)>`, 15 min); 11 sign-ins/min from one IP → `429`.

steps.title: My trips
steps.body: Book a trip while signed in (airline card), then open My bookings.
steps.expect: `GET /v1/bookings?timeframe=upcoming|past|cancelled`; upcoming sorted by departure; the booking has `customer_id` set.

steps.title: Change contact details
steps.body: Change the contact e-mail and phone.
steps.expect: `PATCH /v1/bookings/{id}` (If-Match) → Amadeus PATCH, `booking_contacts` and `bookings.contact_email` updated, `booking.updated` e-mail to the new address with the itinerary, a short notice to the old one. Traveller changes → `403 FEATURE_DISABLED` (travelerChanges).

steps.title: Cancel
steps.body: Press Cancel: the page shows the refund preview, then confirm.
steps.expect: Quote `GET …/cancellation-quote` (cached 10 min in `t:…:cxq:<bookingId>`); `POST …/cancellation` → booking `cancelled`, `booking.cancelled` e-mail, cancelled itinerary PDF; the trip moves to the Cancelled tab.

steps.title: Silent refresh
steps.body: Delete `__Host-vx_at` in the browser and reload a page.
steps.expect: `401 TOKEN_EXPIRED`, the SDK calls `POST /v1/auth/refresh` with the refresh cookie and retries; a rotated refresh token used again → `401 REFRESH_TOKEN_REUSED` and the whole family revoked.

steps.title: Delete the account
steps.expect: `POST /v1/account/deletion` → `202` with `erasureDueBy` (+30 days); `customers.status = deleted`, sessions revoked, `account.deleted` e-mail; Redis `t:<tenantId>:<env>:cust:<id>` = 0 so live access tokens fail with 401.
